items.title: Study Quest hub
items.body: The hub with CS 379 Ethical Hacking (Test 2), CR 370 Origins (Test 3) and SC 141 Astronomy (Test 3). One sign-in works for every guide, with separate callsigns and leaderboards.

items.title: Cleaner layout
items.body: Chapter cards, buttons, footer and stat tiles are lined up.

items.title: New guide: MA 224 Discrete Math (Test 3)
items.body: Sections 5.1 to 7.3, with a Proofs tab: workshop, proof builder, counterexamples and find the error.

items.title: Side menu
items.body: A menu button in every guide lets you switch guides from anywhere.

items.title: Study tools update
items.body: Knowledge studied progress and daily streaks, review of missed questions and weak spots, timed tests, saved questions, search and a printable cheat sheet. A Verses page for CR 370 and a Planets page for SC 141. A suggestion box and Report a problem button. Hub music, mute and animation settings, and back up and restore for your progress.

items.title: Pick up where you left off
items.body: Quizzes and tests now save as you go: switch tabs or guides, or close the page, and you come back to the same question (a timed test pauses while you are away). Each guide also reopens on the page you were on. SC 141 Astronomy has a new Timeline page with BC dates, a Sky coordinates page (RA is like longitude, Dec like latitude), clearer diagrams and reworded questions.

items.title: Progress on all your devices
items.body: Your study progress is now saved to your account: cards known, Knowledge studied, saved items, best scores and even an unfinished quiz or test follow you between your computer and your phone. Progress from both devices is combined, so nothing is lost. The menu shows when it last synced.

items.title: Tougher acronym questions
items.body: "What does the acronym stand for?" questions now offer wrong answers that fit the same letters (for example Cross-Site Request Filtering for CSRF), so you can't spot the right one just by matching letters. Every guide, 128 acronyms.

items.title: Fairer leaderboard, End early and a faster site
items.body: The leaderboard now ranks by an overall score (best test, Knowledge studied, quiz accuracy and time studied) and shows time studied; tap any column to sort. Quizzes and tests have End early and Restart buttons with an "are you sure?" pop-up. Animations run much more smoothly on phones, with no change to how anything looks.

items.title: Verse quiz for Origins
items.body: CR 370 Origins has a new Verses question type: name the reference for a topic, or say what a reference is cited for. Start it from Study → Verses (Quiz the verses or Verse test) or pick Verses under Question type in Quiz and Test. The leaderboard shows Level again.
